evidence:
tools/build_native_host.sh:144-147
if ! FN_NATIVE_PROFILE=... "$ACL2" < "$RUN_BUILD" > "$LOG" 2>&1; then
    echo "build_native_host: acl2 exited with status $?; see $LOG" >&2
fix: Capture the status first: `"$ACL2" < ... > "$LOG" 2>&1 || rc=$?` and test and print $rc.
reviewer: tools/build_native_host.sh:144-147: inside `if ! cmd; then`, $? is the status of the negated pipeline, which is 0, so the message always says 'status 0'. It exits 1 regardless and points at $LOG. The defect is cosmetic, but it does misdirect triage.
scenario: Inside the then-branch of `if ! cmd`, $? is the status of the negated pipeline, which is 0. Every failed image build therefore prints 'acl2 exited with status 0'. An OOM kill (137), a timeout from the swarm-build cgroup and an ACL2 error all look the same, and the line says the process succeeded. Triage of a failed tranche then goes to the wrong cause; the batch runner's builds read this message.
title: build_native_host.sh always reports 'acl2 exited with status 0' on failure
